configuration.checkpoint_selection: mean RAW/CLEAN dev BG coverage at >=98% FG recall; threshold calibrated on dev only
configuration.inference: sigmoid cosine RAW; original lambda_bg=0.2 CLEAN
configuration.input_features: cached OpenVLA final block24 LayerNorm spatial patches
configuration.learning_rate_schedule: cosine over epochs, 5% terminal floor; multiplicative factor shared by optimizer groups
configuration.loss: 0.70 weighted BCEWithLogits(cosine, fractional role occupancy; positive weight 4, negative 1) + 0.30 soft Dice; empty query masks skipped
configuration.text_encoder: frozen OpenAI CLIP ViT-B/16 seven-template average; raw 512-dimensional embeddings cached per task
